verdict.rationale: Zep's underlying Graphiti framework explicitly implements a bi-temporal model and fact invalidation, tracking how facts change over time within the Context Graph, and this is documented both in first-party docs and corroborated by the GitHub repo description. Docs also show fact/edge deletion mechanics tied to this temporal tracking. Missing for 10: no independent hands-on demonstration of querying 'valid at time X' facts, and no explicit user-facing API walkthrough distinguishing current vs. invalidated facts in Zep's cloud product (only in Graphiti's core description).
